name: opal-api
description: OPAL suite OpenAPI contracts (event, listen, say) and their validation tooling.

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint && npm run lint:opal && npm run lint:kernel && npm run lint:look && npm run lint:think && npm run bundle && npm run test:lint && npm run test:event150 && npm run test:think-event && npm run test:look-cli && npm run test:listen150 && npm run test:say150 && npm run test:rest-security
scripts.bundle: redocly bundle openapi/opal_event.yaml -o dist/opal_event.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/opal_listen.yaml -o dist/opal_listen.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/opal_look.yaml -o dist/opal_look.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/opal_say.yaml -o dist/opal_say.yaml && redocly bundle openapi/opal_think.yaml -o dist/opal_think.yaml
